label: S4D state-space model on the trip trace
family_label: State-space and recurrent models (S4D diagonal state space)

compute.notes: r0 0.96, r1 0.90, r2 0.87; + 0.02 for speed benchmarks and a 2-min first launch killed for memory; one thread, shared 2-core machine

feature_engineering: trace-track inputs only: the harness's shared 5-s block means (bake.block_means rule: 8 channel means + mean v^2, mean v^3, summed positive kinetic-energy increment per unit mass) + the block's valid-second fraction -> 12 scaled channels; spec (49) and rl (5, logs of mass / CdA / Crr) standardised with train-bank statistics; log distance and log duration from the trace; chunks of <= 1,440 blocks mean-pooled for longer traces; anchor r0 = sim-train median MJ/km per (architecture, class) (bake.dumb_rates) x distance; from r1: E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs by bake.e_phys_from_trace (EnergyNet's generic road-load estimate; declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input
rule: keep a rung if its full sim val skill beats the incumbent by > 0.01 AND its dev D16 is not worse than the incumbent's by more than 0.01 (HARNESS.md section 7, EnergyNet's model-rung rule)

rungs.change: base: pure trace learner; anchor A0 = sim-train median MJ/km (architecture x class) x distance, no physics estimate; 12 epochs
rungs.why: first rung: what S4D finds from the raw trace alone (skill 0.616, D16 0.115)

rungs.change: physics anchor: target log(E / E_phys) with E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs (bake.e_phys_from_trace), log(E_phys / A0) as an input; 12 epochs from scratch
rungs.why: sim val skill +0.028 over r0 (bootstrap +0.011..+0.038); D16 0.1200 vs 0.1149, worse by 0.005, inside the 0.01 tolerance: kept

rungs.change: 2x training: warm restart from r1 for 12 more epochs (one-cycle cosine, peak lr 1e-3, data stream seed 1)
rungs.why: sim val skill +0.0103 over r1 (bootstrap +0.003..+0.020), just over the 0.01 margin; D16 0.1187 vs 0.1200: kept; released
